subject: Is it necessary to scale Procrustes aligned data during PCA?

messages.author: 96a78639336ed702
messages.subject: Is it necessary to scale Procrustes aligned data during PCA?
parts:
Hi, everyone,

When performing PCA on Procrustes aligned data, gm.prcomp by default does not scale columns of data. However, adding scale=T will initially scale the columns. User manual of geomorph did not mention the scale argument for gm.prcomp. None of the examples for gm.prcomp added scale=T as an argument. I am not sure if this is because it is not recommended to scale Procrustes aligned data during PCA. Any ideas?

Thank you!

Best regards
Lv

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Is it necessary to scale Procrustes aligned data during PCA?
parts:
Lv,

 

Scaling is used when the variables are in different units and/or scale. That is not the case for Procrustes residuals: they are in similar units and scale. Thus, no rescaling is required.

 

Dean
